export const MODEL_TASK_SCHEMA_SHA256 = "@@SCHEMA_SHA256@@";

const MODEL_TASK_SCHEMA = @@SCHEMA_JSON@@ as const;
const DANGEROUS_KEYS = new Set(["__proto__", "constructor", "prototype"]);
const MAX_COLLECTION_ITEMS = 4096;
type JsonRecord = Record<string, unknown>;

function record(value: unknown): JsonRecord | null {
  if (value === null || typeof value !== "object" || Array.isArray(value)) return null;
  const prototype = Object.getPrototypeOf(value);
  if (prototype !== Object.prototype && prototype !== null) return null;
  const candidate = value as JsonRecord;
  return Object.keys(candidate).some((key) => DANGEROUS_KEYS.has(key)) ? null : candidate;
}

function deepEqual(left: unknown, right: unknown): boolean {
  if (Object.is(left, right)) return true;
  if (Array.isArray(left) && Array.isArray(right)) return left.length === right.length && left.every((item, index) => deepEqual(item, right[index]));
  const leftRecord = record(left);
  const rightRecord = record(right);
  if (!leftRecord || !rightRecord) return false;
  const leftKeys = Object.keys(leftRecord).sort();
  const rightKeys = Object.keys(rightRecord).sort();
  return leftKeys.length === rightKeys.length && leftKeys.every((key, index) => key === rightKeys[index] && deepEqual(leftRecord[key], rightRecord[key]));
}

function stableJson(value: unknown): string {
  if (Array.isArray(value)) return `[${value.map(stableJson).join(",")}]`;
  const candidate = record(value);
  if (candidate) return `{${Object.keys(candidate).sort().map((key) => `${JSON.stringify(key)}:${stableJson(candidate[key])}`).join(",")}}`;
  return JSON.stringify(value);
}

function ownedFrozen(value: unknown): unknown {
  if (Array.isArray(value)) {
    if (value.length > MAX_COLLECTION_ITEMS) throw new Error("model task collection exceeds bound");
    return Object.freeze(value.map(ownedFrozen));
  }
  const candidate = record(value);
  if (!candidate) {
    if (value !== null && typeof value === "object") throw new Error("model task object is not plain data");
    return value;
  }
  const keys = Object.keys(candidate);
  if (keys.length > MAX_COLLECTION_ITEMS) throw new Error("model task object exceeds bound");
  const owned = Object.create(null) as JsonRecord;
  for (const key of keys) owned[key] = ownedFrozen(candidate[key]);
  return Object.freeze(owned);
}

function schemaRecord(value: unknown): JsonRecord {
  const candidate = record(value);
  if (!candidate) throw new Error("generated model task schema is malformed");
  return candidate;
}

function resolveReference(reference: unknown): JsonRecord {
  const prefix = "#/$defs/";
  if (typeof reference !== "string" || !reference.startsWith(prefix)) throw new Error("unsupported model task schema reference");
  return schemaRecord(schemaRecord(MODEL_TASK_SCHEMA.$defs)[reference.slice(prefix.length)]);
}

function typeMatches(value: unknown, rawType: unknown): boolean {
  if (rawType === "null") return value === null;
  if (rawType === "boolean") return typeof value === "boolean";
  if (rawType === "integer") return typeof value === "number" && Number.isSafeInteger(value);
  if (rawType === "number") return typeof value === "number" && Number.isFinite(value);
  if (rawType === "string") return typeof value === "string";
  if (rawType === "array") return Array.isArray(value);
  if (rawType === "object") return record(value) !== null;
  return false;
}

function validationErrors(value: unknown, rawSchema: unknown, path: string): string[] {
  const node = schemaRecord(rawSchema);
  if (node.$ref !== undefined) return validationErrors(value, resolveReference(node.$ref), path);
  const errors: string[] = [];
  if (Object.hasOwn(node, "const") && !deepEqual(value, node.const)) errors.push(`${path}: const`);
  if (Array.isArray(node.enum) && !node.enum.some((item) => deepEqual(value, item))) errors.push(`${path}: enum`);
  const alternatives = Array.isArray(node.oneOf) ? node.oneOf : null;
  if (alternatives && alternatives.filter((item) => validationErrors(value, item, path).length === 0).length !== 1) errors.push(`${path}: alternatives`);
  const types = Array.isArray(node.type) ? node.type : node.type === undefined ? [] : [node.type];
  if (types.length > 0 && !types.some((kind) => typeMatches(value, kind))) errors.push(`${path}: type`);
  if (typeof value === "number" && Number.isFinite(value)) {
    if (typeof node.minimum === "number" && value < node.minimum) errors.push(`${path}: minimum`);
    if (typeof node.maximum === "number" && value > node.maximum) errors.push(`${path}: maximum`);
  }
  if (typeof value === "string") {
    const length = Array.from(value).length;
    if (typeof node.minLength === "number" && length < node.minLength) errors.push(`${path}: minLength`);
    if (typeof node.maxLength === "number" && length > node.maxLength) errors.push(`${path}: maxLength`);
    if (typeof node.pattern === "string" && !new RegExp(node.pattern, "u").test(value)) errors.push(`${path}: pattern`);
  }
  if (Array.isArray(value)) {
    if (typeof node.minItems === "number" && value.length < node.minItems) errors.push(`${path}: minItems`);
    if (typeof node.maxItems === "number" && value.length > node.maxItems) return [...errors, `${path}: maxItems`];
    if (node.uniqueItems === true && new Set(value.map(stableJson)).size !== value.length) errors.push(`${path}: uniqueItems`);
    if (node.items !== undefined) value.forEach((item, index) => errors.push(...validationErrors(item, node.items, `${path}/${index}`)));
  }
  const candidate = record(value);
  if (candidate && (types.includes("object") || node.properties !== undefined)) {
    const required = Array.isArray(node.required) ? node.required.filter((item): item is string => typeof item === "string") : [];
    for (const key of required) if (!Object.hasOwn(candidate, key)) errors.push(`${path}/${key}: required`);
    const properties = node.properties === undefined ? {} : schemaRecord(node.properties);
    if (node.additionalProperties === false) for (const key of Object.keys(candidate)) if (!Object.hasOwn(properties, key)) errors.push(`${path}/${key}: additional property`);
    for (const [key, propertySchema] of Object.entries(properties)) if (Object.hasOwn(candidate, key)) errors.push(...validationErrors(candidate[key], propertySchema, `${path}/${key}`));
  }
  return errors;
}

function definition(name: "ModelTaskSpec" | "ModelResultEnvelope"): JsonRecord {
  return schemaRecord(schemaRecord(MODEL_TASK_SCHEMA.$defs)[name]);
}

function contentReferences(value: unknown): ContentReference[] {
  const found: ContentReference[] = [];
  const visit = (item: unknown): void => {
    if (Array.isArray(item)) { item.forEach(visit); return; }
    const candidate = record(item);
    if (!candidate) return;
    if (typeof candidate.aggregateId === "string" && typeof candidate.revisionId === "string" && typeof candidate.contentHash === "string" && typeof candidate.role === "string") found.push(candidate as unknown as ContentReference);
    Object.values(candidate).forEach(visit);
  };
  visit(value);
  return found;
}

function semanticTaskErrors(task: ModelTaskSpec): string[] {
  const errors: string[] = [];
  if (task.input.kind !== task.taskKind) errors.push("task-input-kind-matches-task-kind");
  if (task.input.kind === "reranking" && task.input.topK > task.input.candidates.length) errors.push("reranking-top-k-within-candidate-count");
  return errors;
}

export function modelTaskErrors(value: unknown): readonly string[] {
  const errors = validationErrors(value, definition("ModelTaskSpec"), "$");
  if (errors.length > 0) return errors;
  return semanticTaskErrors(value as ModelTaskSpec);
}

export function decodeModelTask(value: unknown): ModelTaskSpec | null {
  try {
    const snapshot = ownedFrozen(value);
    return modelTaskErrors(snapshot).length === 0 ? snapshot as ModelTaskSpec : null;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

export function assessModelTask(value: unknown, supportedFeatures: readonly string[]): ModelTaskAssessment {
  const task = decodeModelTask(value);
  if (!task) return Object.freeze({ supported: false, diagnosticCode: "model-task-invalid", unsupportedFeatures: Object.freeze([]) });
  const supported = new Set(supportedFeatures);
  const unsupportedFeatures = [...task.requirements.requiredFeatures].filter((feature) => !supported.has(feature)).sort();
  return Object.freeze({
    supported: unsupportedFeatures.length === 0,
    diagnosticCode: unsupportedFeatures.length === 0 ? "model-task-supported" : "model-task-feature-unsupported",
    unsupportedFeatures: Object.freeze(unsupportedFeatures),
  });
}

function selectedRouteMatchesPin(route: SelectedModelRoute, pin: PinnedExecution): boolean {
  return route.providerId === pin.providerId
    && route.providerVersion === pin.providerVersion
    && route.modelId === pin.modelId
    && route.modelVersion === pin.modelVersion
    && route.runtimeId === pin.runtimeId
    && route.runtimeVersion === pin.runtimeVersion
    && route.configurationHash === pin.configurationHash
    && route.evaluationId === pin.evaluationId
    && route.evaluationVersion === pin.evaluationVersion;
}

function indexedOutputErrors(task: ModelTaskSpec, result: ModelResultEnvelope): string[] {
  const input = record(task.input);
  const output = record(result.output);
  if (!input || !output) return [];
  const errors: string[] = [];
  if (task.taskKind === "reranking") {
    const items = output.items as readonly IndexedScore[];
    const candidates = input.candidates as readonly unknown[];
    const indices = items.map((item) => item.inputIndex);
    if (items.length > (input.topK as number) || items.length > candidates.length || indices.some((index) => index >= candidates.length) || new Set(indices).size !== indices.length) errors.push("reranking-output-closes-over-candidates");
  }
  if (task.taskKind === "classification") {
    const items = output.items as readonly IndexedScore[];
    const inputs = input.items as readonly unknown[];
    const labels = new Set(input.labels as readonly string[]);
    const identities = items.map((item) => `${item.inputIndex}|${item.label}`);
    if (items.some((item) => item.inputIndex >= inputs.length || !labels.has(item.label)) || new Set(identities).size !== identities.length) errors.push("classification-output-closes-over-items-and-labels");
  }
  if (task.taskKind === "nli") {
    const scores = output.scores as readonly IndexedScore[];
    const labels = new Set(["entailment", "contradiction", "neutral", "uncertain"]);
    const scoreLabels = scores.map((item) => item.label);
    if (scores.some((item) => item.inputIndex !== 0 || !labels.has(item.label)) || new Set(scoreLabels).size !== scoreLabels.length || !scoreLabels.includes(output.label as string)) errors.push("nli-output-closes-over-task");
  }
  if (task.taskKind === "moderation") {
    const items = output.items as readonly IndexedScore[];
    const inputs = input.items as readonly unknown[];
    const identities = items.map((item) => `${item.inputIndex}|${item.label}`);
    if (items.some((item) => item.inputIndex >= inputs.length) || new Set(identities).size !== identities.length) errors.push("moderation-output-closes-over-items");
  }
  return errors;
}

export function modelResultErrors(taskValue: unknown, resultValue: unknown): readonly string[] {
  const task = decodeModelTask(taskValue);
  if (!task) return ["model-result-task-invalid"];
  const structural = validationErrors(resultValue, definition("ModelResultEnvelope"), "$");
  if (structural.length > 0) return structural;
  const result = resultValue as ModelResultEnvelope;
  const errors: string[] = [];
  if (result.taskId !== task.taskId) errors.push("result-task-id-matches-task");
  if (result.taskKind !== task.taskKind) errors.push("result-task-kind-matches-task");
  if (result.requestHash !== task.requestHash) errors.push("result-request-hash-matches-task");
  if (result.traceId !== task.traceId) errors.push("result-trace-id-matches-task");
  const successful = result.status === "succeeded" || result.status === "degraded";
  if (successful) {
    if (result.output?.kind !== task.taskKind) errors.push("successful-result-output-kind-matches-task-kind");
    if (result.route.selection !== "selected" || result.validation.outcome !== "accepted" || result.policyDecision.outcome !== "allowed") errors.push("successful-result-requires-selected-route-and-accepted-validation");
  } else if (result.output !== null) errors.push("non-success-result-carries-no-output");
  if (result.latency.totalMs < result.latency.queueMs + result.latency.executionMs) errors.push("latency-total-covers-queue-and-execution");
  if (successful && result.latency.totalMs > task.requirements.deadlineMs) errors.push("successful-result-within-task-deadline");
  const usage = result.usage;
  if (usage.reporting === "reported") {
    if (usage.inputTokens === null || usage.outputTokens === null || usage.totalTokens === null || usage.totalTokens !== usage.inputTokens + usage.outputTokens) errors.push("reported-token-total-equals-input-plus-output");
    else if (usage.inputTokens > task.requirements.maxInputTokens || usage.outputTokens > task.requirements.maxOutputTokens) errors.push("reported-usage-within-task-bounds");
  } else if (usage.inputTokens !== null || usage.outputTokens !== null || usage.totalTokens !== null) errors.push("unreported-token-values-are-null");
  const validation = result.validation;
  const artifact = record(result.output)?.artifact;
  const artifactRecord = record(artifact);
  if (validation.outcome === "accepted") {
    if (validation.outputHash === null || validation.errorCodes.length !== 0) errors.push("accepted-validation-has-output-hash-and-no-errors");
    if (artifactRecord && validation.outputHash !== artifactRecord.contentHash) errors.push("accepted-artifact-validation-hash-matches-output");
    if (!successful) errors.push("accepted-validation-requires-successful-output");
  }
  if (validation.outcome === "rejected") {
    if (validation.outputHash === null || validation.errorCodes.length === 0) errors.push("rejected-validation-has-output-hash-and-errors");
    if (result.status !== "failed") errors.push("rejected-validation-requires-failed-status");
  }
  if (validation.outcome === "not-run" && (validation.outputHash !== null || validation.errorCodes.length !== 0)) errors.push("not-run-validation-has-no-output-or-errors");
  if ((result.citationStatus === "supplied") !== (result.citations.length > 0)) errors.push("citation-status-matches-citations");
  if (result.citations.length > 0) {
    const inputs = new Set(contentReferences(task.input).map((item) => `${item.aggregateId}|${item.revisionId}|${item.contentHash}`));
    if (result.citations.some((citation) => !inputs.has(`${citation.sourceAggregateId}|${citation.sourceRevisionId}|${citation.sourceContentHash}`))) errors.push("supplied-citations-close-over-task-input-references");
  }
  if (successful && task.requirements.citationRequirement === "required" && (result.citations.length === 0 || result.citationStatus !== "supplied")) errors.push("required-citations-are-supplied");
  if (task.requirements.citationRequirement === "not-applicable" && (result.citationStatus !== "not-applicable" || result.citations.length !== 0)) errors.push("not-applicable-citations-are-empty");
  if (task.requirements.citationRequirement !== "not-applicable" && result.citations.length === 0 && result.citationStatus !== "not-supplied") errors.push("citation-status-matches-task-requirement");
  if (task.execution.mode === "pinned" && result.route.selection === "selected" && !selectedRouteMatchesPin(result.route, task.execution)) errors.push("pinned-execution-route-matches-result-route");
  if (successful && result.output?.kind === task.taskKind) errors.push(...indexedOutputErrors(task, result));
  if (result.status === "unsupported") {
    const codes = new Set(result.diagnostics.map((item) => item.code));
    if (result.route.selection !== "none" || result.policyDecision.outcome !== "denied" || result.validation.outcome !== "not-run" || !codes.has("model-task-feature-unsupported")) errors.push("unsupported-required-features-fail-explicitly");
  }
  if (result.status === "denied" && (result.route.selection !== "none" || result.policyDecision.outcome !== "denied")) errors.push("denied-result-has-no-route");
  return errors;
}

export function decodeModelResult(task: unknown, value: unknown): ModelResultEnvelope | null {
  try {
    const snapshot = ownedFrozen(value);
    return modelResultErrors(task, snapshot).length === 0 ? snapshot as ModelResultEnvelope : null;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}
